heard: 318 retainers were entombed around Farogirr. The royal cemetery of Um Alqab near Abidos held the earliest rulers. English archaeologist Flinders Petrie excavated these subsidiary graves. The tombs were sealed simultaneously, suggesting these retainers were sacrificed. Forensic re-examination of 46 skulls revealed fatal paramortem fractures. This brutal practice disappeared before the Second Dynasty. Figurines replace the retainers entombed around ferroger.
